verdicts.reason: Both lose the hero can: it is shrunk to a tiny icon in the bottom-left. The glow circle is pulled off to the bottom-right as a flat brown blob that crowds the CTA, and the large starfield panel in the middle is empty with no product in it. A's can is reduced to two orange blocks with no label, leaves or sun, so the brand imagery is gone. B keeps a faintly recognizable can with label and leaves. B's flaws are a logo shoved off-axis to the right while the text sits left-aligned, and a circle that overlaps the starfield panel. B is marginally less bad because of the can.
